info.title: AERIS MUSIC — licensed production music
info.description: Original instrumental music, composed and mastered in-house from synthesis. No samples, no third-party content, so there is nothing for Content ID to match. Three license tiers, each payable per track in USDC on Base over x402, with the master and the license certificate released on settlement. The catalog is machine-readable so an agent can choose a track and pay without a human.

license.name: Per-track commercial license; five tracks additionally CC0

get.summary: List every track with mood, tempo, key, duration, and per-tier checkout URLs
get.description: Free to read. Returns the catalog an agent uses to choose a track before paying.

get.summary: Redeem a settled purchase and obtain the mastered file plus the license certificate
get.description: The delivery payload is released only on settlement. Fetching this route without a settled payment returns 402 with the payment requirements, and the 402 body does not contain the decryption key. With a settled payment the response carries the ciphertext URL, the AES-256-GCM key, and the license text; the master decrypts to a 320 kbps MP3. The key is delivered in the URL fragment and is never sent to the server.
